label: HiRISE (grey)
citation: Fergason et al. 2020, Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE Orthorectified Image Mosaic, USGS, doi:10.5066/P9QJDP48

label: Natural colour
citation: HRSC colour mosaic of Jezero (ESA/DLR/FU Berlin; UDL Lyon mosaic), pan-sharpened with Fergason et al. 2020, Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE Orthorectified Image Mosaic, USGS, doi:10.5066/P9QJDP48
note: Colour comes from a ~50 m orbital mosaic: it shows broad tones, not individual rocks.

label: Minerals (CRISM)
citation: Saranathan, Parente & Itoh, dominant mineralogy of the Mars 2020 landing ellipse (CRISM), doi:10.5281/zenodo.5575823
note: 37% of this area matched a mineral. Bright = high confidence, dull = medium, black = no match. Names are closest-match prototypes, not confirmed identifications.

label: Thermal inertia
citation: Edwards and Buz, THEMIS thermal inertia mosaic of Jezero, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4931347
note: High = rockier/bedrock (slow to cool), low = dusty or sandy. Useful hint for footing.
